name: Volume Fairing via Signed Distance Functions
definition: A preprocessing step to smooth material boundaries in segmented volumes (e.g., from misaligned MR slices) by interpolating between slices using Euclidean Signed Distance Functions (ESDFs), reducing artifacts caused by slice gaps and misalignment.
summary: Volume Fairing via Signed Distance Functions smooths segmented volumetric data by computing 2D Euclidean Signed Distance Functions per slice, enabling efficient interpolation and fairing of multiple material boundaries.
